passage:
A restaurant placed a clear scale near the kitchen to weigh food waste every night. The number was written on a board for all workers to see.
At first, the workers felt uncomfortable. Then they began finding reasons. Some dishes had portions that were too large. Some ingredients were prepared too early and spoiled.
The restaurant changed its menu slightly and offered smaller meal options. Waste dropped within a month.
The owner said the scale did not solve the problem by itself. It made the problem honest.
Waste often hides in bags and bins. Once measured, it becomes harder to ignore and easier to reduce.
